behavior.name: HSR Example Behavior
behavior.author: Lotfi El Hafi
behavior.description: Example of a FlexBE behavior that implements looping navigation for a Toyota HSR (Human Support Robot). The robot loops between two waypoints in the WRS 2020 apartment world, with a configurable wait time at each waypoint.

param.name: wait_time
param.label: wait_time
param.hint: Sets the wait_time at each waypoint (seconds)
